Please provide a complete list, as of 2024 (excluding 2024), of all recognized natural resources in North America (i.e., the United States, Canada, and Mexico), established under the 1972 Convention. This Convention, composed of representatives of 21 member states, meets annually to make decisions and implement its five strategic objectives, centered on credibility, conservation, capacity building, communication, and community engagement. Please include the following information: location (primary county/city), type (cultural, natural, or mixed), area (hectares), and year of recognition. Please indicate "NA" for any information not found online.

Please output the organized data into a Markdown spreadsheet. The columns should be in the following order:
Country, location name, type, location, area, year of recognition.

Do not ask me any questions; simply output the results by column. Do not omit cells. The output format should be ```markdown
{data_content}
```
